newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products rally strongly, U.S. arb dominate.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products rally strongly, U.S. arb dominate.

text.p: NWE oil products rose strongly on Friday, in many cases supported by strong arbitrage interest, traders said.
Gasoline rallied, with Eurograde barges up $8, after crude and gasoline futures and end-user buying surfaced.
Naphtha rose sharply on the back of crude's gains and talk of cargoes heading to the U.S. where rising propane prices have encouraged petchem demand for naphtha.
Gas oil firmed $4 on futures but premiums were stable. An arb for Russian opened to the U.S. and diesel demand into France grew.
Fuel oil prices extended their rally on continued strong U.S. arbitrage buying and solid Italian demand.
